reply.summary: Rumtilveo is a blond swordsman born into a serf bloodline and trained in secret by a noble lover. Rumtilveo bears a ring of raw fury and fights with cunning more than brute force, and has changed sides more than once.

feats.scene: Rumtilveo drives a lance of ring-fire through a fortress gate and the wall behind it.
Rumtilveo shrugs off a collapsing watchtower while his ring flickers.

reply.summary: Lasleo is a white-haired, green-eyed god-soldier who defected from a hard regime to serve a gentler one. Lasleo fights beside a lover in a small elite squad and is quietly cynical about every ruler.

feats.scene: Lasleo hurls a storm of radiant spears that reduces a ridge of cliffs to gravel.
Lasleo takes a direct blast from two rival warriors and is only winded.

reply.summary: Nusvece is a black stallion once bred for polo, now the loyal mount of a masked rider. Nusvece is strong, fast, and fierce enough that bandits back off at the sight of his flared nostrils.

feats.scene: Nusvece kicks a barn door clean off its hinges.
Nusvece gallops flat out across a dry plain with a rider crouched low on his back.

reply.summary: Auianol is a masked crook who plays the part of a jewelled card in a gang of thieves. Auianol picks fights with a young flying hero, and mostly relies on cheap tricks and a handy escape route.

feats.scene: Auianol hurls a razor-edged card that sticks in a plank at the far end of an alley.
Auianol tumbles down a fire escape and bolts for the next rooftop.

reply.summary: Soamces is a black-haired queen of a warrior nation in a world of knights and castles. Soamces fell in love with a foreign princess, stood against a king's lies, and warns enemies she will crush their faces if pushed.

feats.scene: Soamces breaks a heavy iron gauntlet and the arm in it with a single squeeze.
Soamces holds a charging horse at bay with her bare arms.

reply.summary: Rertir is a green-eyed queen who leads a nation of warrior women and rides out against a great horned menace. Rertir had been promised to a neighbouring king, set it aside, then renewed the promise after a funeral.

feats.scene: Rertir cuts a siege ladder in half with one stroke of her sword.
Rertir is knocked from her horse by a mace and rises with her sword raised.

reply.summary: Eorsata is a blue-eyed island princess blessed by the divine with flight and speed, who joined a cartoon team of heroes. Eorsata refuses to laugh at anyone, even a villain, and travels in a plane no instrument can see.

feats.scene: Eorsata hurls a mooring tower across a harbour in a bright, gleeful throw.
Eorsata streaks across the sky faster than a rumour, trailing a ribbon of cloud.

reply.summary: Leslu is a peace-minded champion of an island nation, given gifts by the gods and a rope that forces truth. Leslu resents being called a warrior, and her bracelets turn bullets as easily as raindrops.

feats.scene: Leslu snaps a steel gantry in half to free a trapped crew.
Leslu walks out of a collapsing power station with her hair barely mussed.

reply.summary: Lltautau is the lone child of a vanished warrior people, raised on a barren isle by a sorceress who was herself exiled. Lltautau has two eye colours, blood on both sides of her heritage, and shields the world from gods and monsters alike.

feats.scene: Lltautau tears a fanged monster in half and hurls the halves into a fiery sea.
Lltautau wades through a godly curse that strips the paint from a warship and walks on.

reply.summary: Lloeol is a haughty diplomat-princess from a paradise isle who has worn a ring of death and a ring of light in her time. Lloeol rides a winged steed, prefers conversation to fighting, and looks down on rude company.

feats.scene: Lloeol shatters a stone pier with a single clap of her bracelets.
Lloeol tanks a blast from a ring-powered foe without breaking her smile.

reply.summary: Rauis is a tall, black-haired demigoddess warrior who flies, heals fast, and does not age. Rauis bears a lasso, tiara, and bracelets, and stood on a team of heroes before it came apart.

feats.scene: Rauis hurls a shipping container through the hull of a gunboat.
Rauis shrugs off a barrage of rockets and her wounds close within moments.

reply.summary: Sturi is a diplomat-warrior princess in a cinematic series, with metal-boosted limbs and a wide streak of command. Sturi flies, wields a sword and shield, speaks many tongues, and once fought under another's mind control.

feats.scene: Sturi cleaves a tank turret clean off its mount with her sword.
Sturi is struck by a creature's full-strength blow and slides back only a few paces.

reply.summary: Stiriatiu is a museum curator hiding a war-hardened demigoddess, a godkiller who once wanted to end war. Stiriatiu has learned that love matters more than conquest, and fights on with sword and shield for a flawed humanity.

feats.scene: Stiriatiu lands a downward sword stroke that splits a battlefield crag from top to base.
Stiriatiu absorbs a hammer blow from a rival deity and stays standing.

reply.summary: Cator is a warrior princess in golden armour who left her hidden isle to bring peace to a distant land. Cator carries a sword and shield, wears winged sandals, and answers a refusal of peace with a taste of war.

feats.scene: Cator hurls a throwing disc that snaps a column of marble in two.
Cator catches a boulder on her shield and does not step back.

reply.summary: Lluveval is a gifted but awkward student in a cartoon high school who tops her class and still feels out of place. Lluveval trained from childhood to be perfect, won a tournament in defiance of her mother, and sneaked off to see the wider world.

feats.scene: Lluveval throws a gym mat stack through a cafeteria window.
Lluveval is struck by a runaway school bus and brushes herself off.

reply.summary: Leerson is the cheerful, self-conscious demigod daughter of a queen and a thunder-throwing father, attending a school for gifted teens. Leerson hates showy trophies, bonds with new friends, and rejects the divine half of her family.

feats.scene: Leerson punches a training dummy through the wall of the gym and out onto the lawn.
Leerson stands in a collapsing field house and is only dusty after.

reply.summary: Tesiulan is a game-world champion who flies, hits hard, and mentors fresh heroes in the use of magic. Tesiulan works under a plain name in a government office and answers to a council of heroes.

feats.scene: Tesiulan drives her shield into a giant war machine and splits its torso.
Tesiulan tanks an orbital strike while shielding a group of recruits.

reply.summary: Llunan is a fallen warrior queen whose mind was taken by a plague of mindless hunger. Llunan once held a godlike invader down with her golden rope, only for him to shrug it off and leave, and she now preaches that death is the only constant.

feats.scene: Llunan rips a bridge span from its footings and throws it onto a column of survivors.
Llunan stands in the burning wreck of a skyline and her flesh is unmarked.

reply.summary: Lustilla is a swordswoman who fought through two years of total war alongside a grim partner. Lustilla lost her love early in the fight, grew close to her ally, and was cut down by him over a cursed helmet.

feats.scene: Lustilla splits a stone gate with a sweep of her god-killing blade.
Lustilla is struck by a war god's blast and drops to one knee, stunned.

reply.summary: Llsorrni is an immortal queen and teacher who rides a giant kangaroo and carries a mental radio. Llsorrni is half god, half mortal, strong enough to bend iron, and knows a good many tongues and trades.

feats.scene: Llsorrni brings her sword down on a fortress wall and the whole battlement splits.
Llsorrni is pummelled by a rival army and does not age a day.

reply.summary: Sttel is a lone survivor who led twelve companions up from an underground refuge to save the surface from a returning doom. Sttel emerges in the ruins of an old empire and carries the memory of every comrade who fell on the journey.

feats.scene: Sttel brings a cavern roof down on a pack of pursuing horrors.
Sttel climbs out of a frozen collapse with a broken blade and a fierce stare.

reply.summary: Eorast is a toy-sized android hero in a pastel world of mechanical citizens. Eorast carries a shining headband and wristguards, and quietly obeys a hidden master she cannot see.

feats.scene: Eorast flings a metal bin across the playground into a wall.
Eorast is bumped by a runaway cart and wobbles but stays upright.

reply.summary: Numia is a queen of an island nation who turned her loyalty to a radical cause. Numia befriended a powerful foreign leader, later fell into a captor's hands, and her grey hair marks a long, bitter career.

feats.scene: Numia levels a field gun's barrel with one overhead blow.
Numia takes a tank shell on her shield and slides back only a metre.

reply.summary: Sucinra is a white-haired ancient queen and former war god who stands at the end of time. Sucinra holds the last of a ruined world, faces a primeval evil one more time, and gets a faint word of encouragement from a battered friend.

feats.scene: Sucinra rives a continent-wide rift in the last landmass with a single sword stroke.
Sucinra stands against the collapse of the cosmos and leans on her blade.

reply.summary: Numleorn is a lone wanderer on a battered motorbike who roams a ruined wasteland, helping strangers. Numleorn once swam for days to reach a lost home only to find the shore empty, and is whispered about as a myth by the outcasts.

feats.scene: Numleorn drives a broadsword through the engine block of a raider truck.
Numleorn is flung from her bike at speed and walks away with a limp.

reply.summary: Teltirnt is a kid-sized hero in a cartoon club of tiny crusaders. Teltirnt wears a bright headband and bracelets, wants to help, and takes everything a little too seriously.

feats.scene: Teltirnt shoves a toy cart across the classroom and knocks a stack of chairs flat.
Teltirnt tumbles down the slide and bounces up at the bottom.

reply.summary: Llain is a brown-eyed, divinely gifted hero in a pint-sized comedy of costumed heroes. Llain sorts out a mess caused by a love potion and fights her sworn feline rival on a satellite base.

feats.scene: Llain knocks a rival through a wall of reinforced glass.
Llain absorbs a swing from a giant mallet and hardly notices.

reply.summary: Anniti is a godly champion who fights in a tournament crossover against a field of masked fighters. Anniti loses to two foes, then returns home, finds strange relics, and arms herself against a looming evil.

feats.scene: Anniti drives a fist into a stone arena wall and brings down a whole section.
Anniti takes a two-handed hammer blow from a bruiser and keeps her footing.

reply.summary: Neranto is a brick-built warrior who takes a seat among a council of inventive builders. Neranto is captured by a police force, freed by a clumsy hero, and fights a robot horde in a toy city.

feats.scene: Neranto kicks through a wall of plastic masonry and scatters its bricks across the lot.
Neranto is crushed under a stack of towers and clicks herself back together.

reply.summary: Iaamsa is a big-sister mentor in a cartoon where every hero is a pocket-sized child. Iaamsa flies, hits hard, and catches thieves with a golden rope, all while signing a patient word to her pupils.

feats.scene: Iaamsa lifts a toy-sized treehouse over her head and hauls it across a field.
Iaamsa takes a tumble through a pile of furniture and giggles.

reply.summary: Lastau is a clay-born princess raised on a hidden isle after a long war with the god of battle. Lastau trained until she outfought her own aunt, then chased a crash-landed pilot and began a journey far from home.

feats.scene: Lastau hurls a boulder across a canyon and tears a mast from a passing ship.
Lastau takes a god-forged club on her bracers and the shockwave scours the beach.

reply.summary: Licor is a black-eyed champion who flattened a world in a rage and spent centuries guarding what remained. Licor flies, heals, hits with lightning, never dies, and tells stories to survivors as they huddle against mutated horrors.

feats.scene: Licor smashes the crust of a continent into a field of broken glass in a single fit of fury.
Licor endures a punishing duel against a rival of equal might and her hair is barely singed.

reply.summary: Ialan is a nurse who lent her name to a famous princess and later asked for it back. Ialan has a baby and an inventor husband, and her life was once threatened by spies who wanted his work.

feats.scene: Ialan shoves a heavy medical cart into a spy's knees.
Ialan is bundled into a car boot and keeps her head in the dark.

reply.summary: Lianianum is the curator of a famed gallery in a sunny coastal city, with a keen eye for old relics. Lianianum receives mysterious carved runes from a dig and senses that her field archaeologist may be in trouble.

feats.scene: Lianianum hefts a crate of relics onto a trolley and wheels it down the hall.
Lianianum slips on polished marble and catches herself on a display case.

reply.summary: Ulseor is a dark-haired military nurse who tends wounded soldiers on the front line. Ulseor works long shifts in a field hospital and keeps calm no matter how many arrive at once.

feats.scene: Ulseor hauls a wounded soldier on a stretcher through a flooded trench.
Ulseor is bowled over by a shell blast and gets up to keep working.

reply.summary: Torna is a blond farm girl turned test pilot who married an airman and raised a son. Torna flew supply missions through wartime, took up a new jet for the thrill, and vanished after lightning clipped her wing over open water.

feats.scene: Torna hauls a full ferry satchel up a ladder and slams the canopy shut.
Torna ejects from a tumbling jet and survives the plunge into cold water.

reply.summary: Collu is a green-eyed executive who funds her costumed double life through a company that hands out scholarships. Collu runs a public campaign against a corrupt drug firm and has the press on her side, and the law watching her.

feats.scene: Collu kicks in a warehouse door and drags a witness out by the collar.
Collu takes a baton to the ribs and keeps walking toward the van.

reply.summary: Relen is a red-haired hunting goddess of an old empire who sold out her fellow gods to a shattering power. Relen survived while her kin were turned to stone, then used the same curse on an island of warriors.

feats.scene: Relen turns a whole island's population to stone in a single sweep of her arm.
Relen is struck by a pantheon's combined blows and merely staggers.

reply.summary: Tortecor is a blond police detective who partners with a calm, quiet colleague and believes he is the finest sleuth alive. Tortecor catches the odd modest dig from her partner, and takes it in good humour.

feats.scene: Tortecor shoulders open a stuck interview-room door.
Tortecor is bumped down a stairwell by a fleeing suspect and gets up cursing.

reply.summary: Taani is a white-haired film director who hides a second life as a golden-masked mage. Taani has a taste for spectacle on set and off, and treats his magic like a very expensive special effect.

feats.scene: Taani conjures a golden pillar of flame that burns down a set in seconds.
Taani is thrown from a camera crane and lands in a cloud of confetti.

reply.summary: Neocetel is a brown-haired fighter of a sisterhood of archers and riders who guard a hidden island. Neocetel held the shore against a swarm of machines and trusts her training above all else.

feats.scene: Neocetel looses an arrow that pins a mechanical raider to a palm trunk.
Neocetel takes a heavy blow from a machine's arm and keeps her bow steady.

reply.summary: Meliunt is a hulking criminal who slips into a high school disguised as a mild art teacher to steal lab chemicals. Meliunt breaks free of police restraints with a surge of drug-fuelled strength, then is led away again.

feats.scene: Meliunt snaps a pair of steel handcuffs with a flex of his shoulders.
Meliunt takes a thrown desk across the back and laughs.

reply.summary: Niarelu is a bald thug in the pay of a rabbit-themed gang who can swell his body to a larger size. Niarelu lifts a man with one hand and shrugs off small-arms fire.

feats.scene: Niarelu swells and lifts a gunman off his feet with one hand.
Niarelu takes a point-blank pistol volley and only grunts.

reply.summary: Lleriaosa is a blond teenager from a city shrunk in a bottle who poses as a gadget-using wonder boy abroad. Lleriaosa hides his real gifts, never flashes his gaze, and fakes the loss of his powers to go home.

feats.scene: Lleriaosa lets a hot beam from his eyes slip and melts a girder before covering his tracks.
Lleriaosa catches a runaway cart in his arms and pretends it was a trick.

reply.summary: Iasti is a dark-haired scholar of a sisterhood of archers who pored over old scrolls with her queen. Iasti read about child-rearing when the knowledge had faded, and can ride and fight when the day demands.

feats.scene: Iasti draws a war bow and sinks an arrow in a wooden shield.
Iasti is thrown from a pony and gets up laughing.

reply.summary: Rnitiamo is a brown-eyed police sergeant in a mirrored world who secretly helped a masked bomber. Rnitiamo grilled a rich businessman for clues and was arrested just as her whole reality faded.

feats.scene: Rnitiamo slams an interview-room table against a suspect's knees.
Rnitiamo is cuffed to a bench and shrugs off a rough shove.

reply.summary: Ialstalin is a blond teen vocalist at a school for gifted teens who forms a band and loses a contest over a stolen aircraft. Ialstalin dissolves the group after a stint in custody and chases a solo career.

feats.scene: Ialstalin hurls a microphone stand at a rival drummer's kit and topples the cymbals.
Ialstalin tumbles off a stage into the crowd and bounces to her feet.

reply.summary: Eotaar is a green-eyed fashion model in a sunny coastal city who studied karate in her spare time. Eotaar began as a rival to her neighbour and ended up a friend.

feats.scene: Eotaar breaks a stack of roof tiles with the edge of her hand.
Eotaar takes a hard fall on a polished runway and bounces up with a smile.

reply.summary: Teorete is a blond vigilante who stalks a rainy northwest city, convinced no woman should be a default victim. Teorete went after a bow-wielding killer, was mistaken for a hostage, and turned her captor's mistake against him.

feats.scene: Teorete fires a revolver through the door of a locked cellar.
Teorete is bound and dragged across a gravel yard, then slips her ropes.

reply.summary: Riacolre is a blond masked crimefighter from a bygone generation of heroes who vanished from her family. Riacolre was framed by a secret agency for crimes she did not commit, and passed her calling to her daughter.

feats.scene: Riacolre drives a boot through a locked warehouse door.
Riacolre is thrown against a brick wall by an agent and keeps swinging.
